University · Public University

Gaza University

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational

Gaza University is a public university in Gaza City with multiple branches across the Strip, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in arts, law, commerce, and education. It served thousands of students from across the Gaza governorates.

Incident history (2)

📅 2023-04-12 Destroyed INC-030
University of Gaza was bombed and appeared destroyed

There are some reports of Gaza University being bombed on 4 Dec, 2023 but there do not seem to be any main stream news sources that confirm this, and one report puts the date of the attack as 1 Dec, 2023. "In December 2023, Israeli airstrikes heavily targeted Gaza University and its main campus in al-Zeitoun neighbourhood. Four other university buildings suffered partial damage. The University's branch in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, was also bombed, raided, and destroyed, as was its Khan Younis branch."
